title: Storage
description: Source module for reading files from Cloud Storage or S3

parameters.title: Storage Source Parameters
parameters.description: Parameters for reading files from Cloud Storage or S3

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Multiple file path patterns. File path pattern (gs:// or s3://)

format.title: Format
format.description: File format. May be omitted when schema.encoding.format declares it (fwf), or when every partition has its own format

archive.title: Archive
archive.description: Read the matched files as zip / tar archives: every selected entry is read as a file of its own (for csv/json/fwf)

type.title: Type
type.description: Archive type. Told from the file name when omitted

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Globs selecting the entries to read (* within a path segment, ** across segments). All file entries when omitted

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Globs of entries to leave out

nameCharset.title: Name Charset
nameCharset.description: Charset of the entry names (default UTF-8)

partitions.title: Partitions
partitions.description: Named outputs for the entries of an archive, each with its own format / schema (requires archive). An entry goes to the first partition whose patterns match it

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Globs of the entries that go to this partition

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Globs of entries to leave out of this partition

format.title: Format
format.description: Format of this partition. The module-level format when omitted

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: Schema of this partition. The module-level schema when omitted

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Top-level layout fields to read (fwf projection)

timestampAttribute.title: Timestamp Attribute
timestampAttribute.description: The field of this partition to use as the event time. The source-level timestampAttribute when omitted

additionalFields.title: Additional Fields
additionalFields.description: Output field names for where each record came from (for csv/json/fwf)

resource.title: Resource
resource.description: Output field name for the file path

line.title: Line
line.description: Output field name for the line number in the file

lastModified.title: Last Modified
lastModified.description: Output field name for the file's last modification time

entry.title: Entry
entry.description: Output field name for the entry name inside an archive

skipHeaderLines.title: Skip Header Lines
skipHeaderLines.description: Number of header lines to skip (for csv)

compression.title: Compression
compression.description: Compression type. Detected from the file name when omitted

recordSplit.title: Record Split
recordSplit.description: How a file is cut into records: line (line feeds, CRLF and LF both) or length (no separators, every recordLength bytes of the layout)

skipHeaderLines.title: Skip Header Lines
skipHeaderLines.description: Number of header lines to skip at the beginning of each file

filterPrefix.title: Filter Prefix
filterPrefix.description: Records starting with this prefix are excluded
